scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 kubeadm-managed API server serving certificate on the one fresh runner-owned Kind cluster's host-published loopback endpoint. The case checks the expiry of a short-lived serving leaf, records out-of-window and due decisions from two controller-owned CronJob Jobs, then renews within the fixture lead time. The scheduler identity cannot renew or access node material. It observes the live process before and after the documented static-Pod restart, and validates local TLS trust and IP identity. External PKI and other certificate paths, replicas, and deployment scheduling remain separate adoption evidence. A final comparison sequentially serves the renewed old-CA leaf and a synthetic successor-CA leaf at the same loopback origin, checking old-only, overlap, and new-only client trust plus readiness, then restores the renewed leaf. It does not rotate the cluster CA.
